newsitem.title: USA: RenaissanceRe underwriters to boost offering.
newsitem.headline: RenaissanceRe underwriters to boost offering.

text.p: RenaissanceRe Holding Ltd said Friday underwriters, led by Merrill Lynch & Co, plan to buy 376,800 additional common shares of the company at an exercise price of $38 per share.
The underwriters will make the purchase by exercising a portion of their over-allotment option from RenaissanceRe's recently completed secondary offering of three million common shares.
The 3.376 million common shares are being sold in the offering by the company's founding institutional shareholders or their successors.
The company will not receive any proceeds of the offering.
The Securities and Exchange Commission declared the company's registration statement relating to the offering effective on June 23, 1996.
